title: The Latest Crier for Jan 22, 2026
items:
Friday Night Flight - Paper Airplane Contest - Maytag - 8 to 10pm

Stop by the Maytag Atrium Friday night for a little paper airplane challenge! Let's see if you got what it takes to make, launch and pilot the best paper airplane on campus in the following categories: 
-longest flight 

-coolest design 

-straightest flier & more! 

*Prizes for each category!

EnVision Vision Board Night

Join us for Vision Board Night and kick off the semester by creating your own vision board. All materials will be provided. We’ll be in the Maytag Atrium on Saturday, the 24th, from 7–9 PM . We can’t wait to see you there!

Intermurals 5v5 basketball

5v5 Basketball season is starting up this weekend! Season Schedule: 

• 1/25 & 2/1 – Pool Play 

• 2/15 – Tournament Play 

(No games on Super Bowl Sunday) 

Using the link below, Signup your basketball team or signup as an individual and we will help you find a team! 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSFveQpSvz0fRw0YcyEPqc_2JFshpvx99qdC6V97_iP82L_A/viewform 

Deadline is Friday, 1/23 

Location - Fieldhouse 

Game times - 7-9pm. Winners get a Central Intramural Champion shirt! 

Email wisemans@central.edu with any questions you may have.
